_comment: VEX source (#1832): one statement per RUSTSEC vulnerability deny.toml ignores, i.e. one we have triaged as not affecting Pollis. scripts/oss-inventory.mjs turns these into each product's OpenVEX document (only for packages that product ships); `oss-inventory.mjs check-vex` (supply-chain.yml) fails when this file and deny.toml's ignore list disagree. `affected` is the advisory's vulnerable version range; `aliases` must include every alias the advisory lists (CVE / GHSA ids are what customers' scanners report). `justification` is an OpenVEX justification. Write `impact_statement` for a customer: what the flaw needs, and why Pollis never gives it that.
